stem.text: The diagram represents the Haber process for the manufacture of ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen.

stem.alt: Haber process flow diagram: N2 + H2 feed enters a heat exchanger, then a condenser where NH3 is drawn off at the bottom, then a catalytic converter, with the gas stream looping back through the heat exchanger.

stem.text: What is the purpose of the heat exchanger?

A.text: to cool the incoming gas mixture to avoid overheating the catalyst

B.text: to cool the reaction products and separate the $\text{NH}_3$ from unused $\text{N}_2$ and $\text{H}_2$

C.text: to warm the incoming gas mixture and shift the equilibrium to give more $\text{NH}_3$

D.text: to warm the incoming gas mixture and speed up the reaction
